title: Church Membership
definition: Church membership is a believer's committed identification with a local church for worship, discipleship, accountability, service, and mission.
summary: Membership reflects the biblical reality that Christians belong to Christ and to one another in visible fellowship.
christFocus: Christ saves individuals into a people who are called to love, serve, and build one another up.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Membership reflects the biblical reality that Christians belong to Christ and to one another in visible fellowship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
